title: COVID-19 Market Shock
summary: The global spread of COVID-19 coincided with a sharp market drawdown, widespread mobility restrictions, supply disruptions, and aggressive fiscal and monetary responses.
transmission_mechanisms: Demand shock from lockdowns and uncertainty
Supply-chain disruption across manufacturing and trade
Rapid repricing of risk and volatility expansion
Policy easing and liquidity support during the recovery phase
notes: Associations shown are descriptive and educational, not causal proof.

title: Global Inflation Surge
summary: A combination of reopening demand, supply bottlenecks, energy shocks, and policy normalization coincided with a broad inflation surge across many economies.
transmission_mechanisms: Valuation multiples became more sensitive to discount rates
notes: Charts illustrate co-movement and timing rather than definitive causation.

title: AI Investment Boom
summary: Rapid enthusiasm around generative AI coincided with elevated capex expectations, semiconductor demand optimism, and selective outperformance among platform and infrastructure firms.
transmission_mechanisms: Expectations for productivity gains and cloud demand
Higher capex for AI infrastructure and chips
Expansion in revenue narratives for software and platform businesses
notes: Narratives are illustrative and should not be interpreted as investment recommendations.
